title: When the Harbor Turns
author: Kestrel Yarrow
blurb: Dominic Thornbury, a battlefield nurse keeping a ledger of the names officers omit, has spent fifteen years learning which silences keep people safe. Then the army requisitions the town and the ledger with all the names — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must finish the work while the workshop still stands before the century turns.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
